item.viltrumitecore.od_lagna_wish.desc: The warm light of an ancient power that hears every plea.
gui.viltrumitecore.wish.title: what do you wish for?
wish.viltrumitecore.time.echo: The world will stand still at a single word from you.
wish.viltrumitecore.death: I wish to rule over death
wish.viltrumitecore.death.echo: The fallen will rise and call you master.
wish.viltrumitecore.thunder: I wish for the power of the god of thunder
wish.viltrumitecore.thunder.echo: The sky will answer you with thunder.
wish.viltrumitecore.reality: I wish to rewrite reality itself
wish.viltrumitecore.reality.echo: The world will be your stage, and miracles your craft.
wish.viltrumitecore.genius: I wish to wear armour forged by my own genius
wish.viltrumitecore.genius.echo: Your mind will become your shield.
wish.viltrumitecore.crimson: I wish for the world to kneel before me
wish.viltrumitecore.crimson.echo: Your gaze will turn to fire, and the sky will be yours.
wish.viltrumitecore.sword: I wish to be the strongest of knights
wish.viltrumitecore.sword.echo: Fortune itself will stand at your side.
wish.viltrumitecore.untouchable: I wish that nothing could ever touch me
wish.viltrumitecore.untouchable.echo: Time around you will freeze, and you will never change.
wish.viltrumitecore.return: I wish to have my old life back
wish.viltrumitecore.return.echo: The light will let you go, and you will be yourself again.
wish.viltrumitecore.refused.unavailable: This wish cannot be granted right now.
wish.viltrumitecore.refused.already: This wish has already been granted.
wish.viltrumitecore.refused.no_item: You must hold Od Lagna's Wish.
wish.viltrumitecore.refused.busy: Finish what you have started first.
wish.viltrumitecore.refused.time_still: Time stands still: the wish is not heard.
wish.viltrumitecore.refused.bound: A foreign power holds you fast.
wish.viltrumitecore.refused.no_room: There is no room here for such a wish.
wish.viltrumitecore.shield: I wish to stand up first and never give in
wish.viltrumitecore.shield.echo: You will stand when everyone else has fallen.
